done_when: Forge starts a new worker run only while machine load per core is under 1.5, and worker test runs use at most two test processes, so queue waits stay under five minutes per round

dismissals.because: Human accepted the remaining finding: Coordinator decision under the owner's bar (Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 1): the cap covers test runs Forge starts; a pytest.ini addopts -n setting is left as a follow-up fix. Recorded as lived-with.

findings.body: Raise: Not done. A worker in a repo whose `forge.toml` runs plain pytest and whose `pytest.ini` sets `addopts = -n 4` still starts four test processes through `forge test`. The new cap is added only when the command text contains an xdist option; pytest's configured options are absent from that text. `src/forge/fasttest.py:31-54` already reads these options for the separate `--pytest` path, but `forge test` can run the configured command directly (`src/forge/fasttest.py:253-265`). The named proof puts `-n 4` in the command itself, so it passes while this supported configuration exceeds the two-process limit.
